shared_elements: horizontal band/register of signs or pattern
justification: The main overlap is only broad: both surfaces include human/anthropomorphic imagery plus incised linear signs, circular forms, and some band-like decoration. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a single frontal, highly abstract body/figure with geometric body markings, while B shows a narrative/profile scene with two human figures, an offering/table arrangement, and rows of script-like signs.
